base_checkpoint_selection: lowest rounded-count overall validation MSE; no final reference pixels; identity step-zero fallback
strength_selection: lowest rounded validation count MSE strictly below identity, with no pooled or per-group overall/shadow/highlight/detail MSE increase; exact existing region_guard; identity fallback if no strength qualifies
candidate_family: one fresh best-overall F_ane_no_sr checkpoint; vary existing residual_scale metadata only
final_evaluation: only if a nonidentity strength qualifies; freeze checkpoint SHA before final evaluation; no final pixels for selection
limitations: same historical reference collection; not a new unseen test set
